node.statement: Fix such a diagonal. For g(X,Y)=v(XY)-v(X)v(Y), define w_prime(X)=sum_j v(A_j)g(B_j,X), w_doubleprime(X)=w_prime(X^dagger)^dagger, w=(w_prime+w_doubleprime)/2, and v^+=v+w. For all n, I_n tensor w is exactly the correction obtained from v_n and I_n tensor D, and there is a universal C_w such that sup_n ||I_n tensor w|| <= C_w d whenever d+epsilon is sufficiently small.
